title: Authorize document number rules with live menu authority and numbering-rule bounds
description:
Stage 3 document-control closure for the rules that mint every operational document number. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs:21-30 declares [ApiController]/[Route("api/sys/document-number-rules")]/[Authorize] over BaseCrudController<SysDocumentNumberRule> with no identity or menu resolution, so the inherited generic routes (src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92) let any authenticated account list, create, update and delete the rules that src/ERP.Application/Services/DocumentNumberService.cs:56-57 reads to generate sales, purchase, stock-in/out, transfer, adjustment, loading, receipt and payment numbers that carry CurrentSequence. SysDocumentNumberRule (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:52-89) persists DocumentType, RuleCode, Prefix, DateFormat, SerialLength, Separator, CurrentSequence and YearlyReset with no bound rule. Reuse the existing doc-rule functional menu (SeedData.Menus.cs:20) on every route and add server-side bounds so a rule cannot be rewritten into an unusable or duplicate numbering shape, keeping DocumentNumberService's default fallback (prefix + yyyyMMdd + 4-digit serial) and the numbering sequence semantics unchanged. Add no grants, no anonymous/admin fallback, no schema change. Genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
Acceptance reopened 20261009T0807: Independent real SQL acceptance failed 4/12 tests, preserved full log/TRX/target at .ai/logs/heartbeat-20261009T0807-original-failures. UniqueCode uses unconditional [..40] on shorter GUID prefix strings and throws before exercising business denial. Number-generation assertions incorrectly expect fallback SOC/XTH instead of configured fixture DR prefix; SeedData already has an active SalesReturn rule so newly seeded rule is not selected. Minimal isolated fixture repair in .ai/logs/ERP-311-repair-validation-20261005/src/ERP.IntegrationTests/DocumentNumberRuleAuthorizationSqlServerTests.cs uses Math.Min(40,code.Length), expects configured DR prefix, and explicitly initializes the actual selected SalesReturn fixture rule before the before-snapshot to prefix DR/date yyyyMMdd/serial4/sequence1. It preserves snapshot equality after denied writes and expected one increment to2, all authorization and production validation. Corrected isolated safe Release 0 warnings/errors and 7 real SQL cases plus 5 guards passed in a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST dedicated localdb. Apply minimum fixture correction within existing allowed_paths, run real SQL and full existing gates; do not relax validations, suppress assertions, change production numbering or widen permissions. Build or guard-only tests do not fulfill real SQL acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/document-number-rules (paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch-delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing doc-rule functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that DocumentType is a known document type, RuleCode is non-empty and unique within the existing unique rule-code semantic, Prefix, Separator and DateFormat stay within their persisted bounds and the date format is a supported shape, SerialLength stays within a bounded positive range, CurrentSequence is non-negative, and rejected writes mutate no SysDocumentNumberRules row, consume no number and leave DocumentNumberService's default fallback and existing sequence semantics unchanged.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing doc-rule menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid rule payloads, and assert that denied create, update and delete calls leave no rule row changed and no generated operational number consumed while the existing DocumentNumberServiceTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs:21-30 declares DocumentNumberRuleController with only [ApiController]/[Route("api/sys/document-number-rules")]/[Authorize] over BaseCrudController<SysDocumentNumberRule>; it defines no action of its own, so the inherited generic CRUD in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92 runs with zero Authoriz/Menu/scope references and no field validation. SysDocumentNumberRule (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:52-89) persists DocumentType/RuleCode/Prefix/DateFormat/SerialLength/Separator/CurrentSequence/YearlyReset without any bound rule, and src/ERP.Application/Services/DocumentNumberService.cs:56-57 loads the matching rule to mint numbers for every operational document type (defaults fallback documented at 54-56). The existing doc-rule menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:20. An exact search of .ai/tasks shows ERP-429 only restored server-side numbering for purchase-order HTTP forms and no task lists DocumentNumberRuleController for live authorization.
